Ravi: Starting canary for aphelion-20B-int4x. Seeing two OOMs and p99 spikes during long generation. Quick paste of runtime tail.
Elena: paste logs plz, suspect large workspace alloc + fragmentation.
Ravi: log excerpt:
```
E 11:02:03 oom: workspace alloc failed (req=448MB)
W 11:02:03 allocator: fragmented=true free_chunks=13 largest_free=36MB
I 11:02:04 kv_cache: size=1.1GB autotrim=off
```
Tom: thanks. What did we set for defaults?
Ravi: canary defaults:
```
model: aphelion-20B-int4x
max_new_tokens: 900
batch_size: 6
kv_prefetch: eager
reserve_mb: 0
microbatch: false
```
Elena: 900 + batch 6 + eager-kv is risky on shared slots. Quick mitigations: max_new_tokens=320, batch_size=3, microbatch=true(mb=2), reserve_mb=200, kv_prefetch=adaptive. Also set slab_compact_interval=5s.
Ravi: updated proposal and kicking a small microbench before bumping canary.
kai-bot: canary deploy (Ravi) -> aphelion-20B-int4x @3% with revised defaults. Monitoring p95/p99/oom_count/kv_evictions.
bench-bot: synthetic run (5k reqs) after changes: p95 -23%, p99 -19%, mem headroom +280MB, OOMs 0/30m, quality delta -0.28% vs fp16 baseline.
Tom: quality dip small; for long-form routes we can pin to dedicated-20B or allow higher max_new_tokens there. Add soft-fallback to aphelion-16B-compat if OOM_rate > 0.7% over 5m.
Ravi: action items: update model-catalog defaults (Ravi), add fallback rule (Tom), monitor 1h soak (Elena). Will post final numbers. :thumbsup:
